messages:
Morgan: quick heads-up — we'll flip a couple runtime flags for the autoscaler and the new circuit-breaker behavior in prod tonight. low-risk but want oncall visibility.
Alex: ack. what's the rollout window?
Morgan: planning 23:30-00:30 UTC. freeze window from 00:00-04:00 UTC so no unrelated deploys then.
Priya: I can take coverage from 23:15 until 01:00, then Alex holds until 04:30 unless an issue.
Alex: noted. I'll be on pager from 01:00-04:30. Priya — can you leave quick handoff notes when you pass?
Priya: yup. will post checklist and a TL;DR before I hand over.
Sam: rough risk profile? any expected errors or latency blips to watch for?
Morgan: expect occasional model fallback for long requests (we're tightening mem threshold). latency might bump ~150-300ms p50 for some routes. errors: watch for 502/504s and repeated `kvcache-miss` spikes.
Katie: tagging relevant dashboards: /dash/model-serving/latency, /dash/autoscaler/ooms. set retention to 2h during rollout.
Alex: good. who's the rollback owner if circuit-breaker causes problems?
Morgan: App infra (me) will own rollback toggle. Steps in case of regressions:

```# emergency rollback
rctl rollout set-cb --service model-serving --state off
rctl autoscaler set-profile --service model-serving --profile stable
# notify oncall channel and ops
```
Priya: leaving these quick watch tasks before handoff: 1) confirm canary 10% passed 5m smoke (endpoint /health, /predict-smoke) 2) confirm no spike in 5xxs 3) monitor model fallback rate 4) if >1% 5xx or fallback >10% in 10m, escalate to Morgan and Alex.
Sam: will ping infra test harness to run a short load test at 23:35 to simulate prefix cache pressure.
Morgan: thanks. also enabling circuit-breaker throttles gradually: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 30m with 10m holds. will post each step.
Alex: deploy-bot — kick off canary when ready please.
deploy-bot: Canary job started for model-serving v2.14. Canary targets: 10% traffic. Job id: cb-canary-2316009999. Logs: https://ci.internal/canaries/cb-canary-2316009999
Priya: canary smoke at 23:36 PASS (health ok, latency nominal).
Sam: load test started 23:35, slight tail latency increase but stable.
Alex: monitoring realtime: p95 up ~200ms on a couple routes but error rate stable.
Katie: added watchers: @oncall, @platform-ops for the rollout window. also set alert: if 5xx rate > 0.5% for 5m, page L2.
Priya: handing off to Alex at 01:00 UTC — notes below: 1) keep an eye on fallback ratio 2) if canary hold at 40% for >20m without regressions, Morgan will continue to ramp 100% 3) if rollback needed run rollback snippet + ping #incidents.
Alex: got it. I'll update this thread if anything changes.
Morgan: thanks all. final note: this is low-risk but want to be conservative — no non-critical deploys until 04:30 UTC.
Alex: confirmed. I'll maintain watch and post a short status at 02:00 and 04:30.
Priya: ty, handing off now :wave:
Alex: takeover acknowledged — taking point.
deploy-bot: Canary ramp to 40% completed at 23:55 UTC.
Alex: quick status 00:45 UTC — still green. p95 elevated in two regions, but no error spike. keeping ramp as planned.
Alex: status 02:00 UTC — stable. leaving notes for Morgan on final ramp next cycle.
Morgan: noted, will finish ramp to 100% at 03:10 UTC if stable.
Alex: final check 04:30 UTC — rollout complete, no rollback needed. closing watch. Great handoff everyone :thumbsup:
